applicable_when: The kernel launches a single CTA (grid=1x1x1) on a 132-SM H200. M=64 and N=16 fit exactly into one BLOCK_M=64 x BLOCK_N=16 tile, so the MxN tile grid is 1x1. The batch dimension (program_id(1)) is also set to 1 in the launch, ignoring 32767 remaining batch elements (total batch = 2048*2*8 = 32768). The fix has two parts: (1) expand program_id(1) to cover all 32768 batch elements, and (2) apply split-K by partitioning K=64 across SPLIT_K CTAs (program_id(2)), accumulating partial dot products with tl.atomic_add. This converts the 1-CTA launch into a 32768xSPLIT_K CTA launch, saturating all 132 SMs.
